items.source: Batches are atomic by default. In the context of a Cassandra batch operation, atomic means that if any of the batch succeeds, all of it will. Statement order does not matter within a batch. CassandraBatchOperations applies all rows using the same timestamp if supplied, otherwise Cassandra will generate a timestamp.
items.translation: 批次默认是原子的。在 Cassandra 批量操作的上下文中，原子性意味着如果批处理中的任何一条语句成功，则整个批次都将成功。批次内的语句顺序无关紧要。CassandraBatchOperations 接口会应用相同的timestamp（如果提供的话），否则 Cassandra 将自动生成时间戳。

items.source:
Multi partition batches should only be used to achieve atomicity for a few writes on different tables. Apart from
this they should be avoided because they’re too expensive. Single partition batches can be used to get atomicity and
isolation, they're not much more expensive than normal writes.
items.translation: 多分区批处理仅应用于少数跨不同表的写入操作以实现原子性。除此之外，应避免使用它们，因为其成本过高。单分区批处理可用于实现原子性和隔离性，其开销与常规写入相差不大。

items.source: Batch operations for insert/update/delete actions on a table. CassandraBatchOperations use logged Cassandra BATCHes for single entities, collections of entities, and statements. A CassandraBatchOperations instance cannot be modified/used once it was executed.
items.translation: 对表执行插入、更新和删除操作的批量操作。CassandraBatchOperations 使用已记录的 Cassandra BATCH 语句来处理单个实体、实体集合以及statements。一旦执行，CassandraBatchOperations 实例即不可修改或再次使用。
